Chapter 1184: Chapter 7 Galaxy Venerate (Request Subscription)

The Beiyin Venerate and Jihan Venerate were two ancient Heavenly Venerates of the Xuanyin Ancient Country.

Their mental awareness compared to other Heavenly Venerates was slightly lacking.

Thus, they were deeply eager for the rare Hei Yu produced by the Hei Yu Nest.

With the rotation of the Hei Yu Nest’s guardians this time, they planned to take the risky move of infiltrating.

In truth, it wasn’t quite a risk, as Beiyin Venerate had fully prepared for this action.

The new guardian Galaxy Great Lord, though far superior to other extreme core royalty, had ultimately not crossed into the Heavenly Venerate Realm.

Naturally, he was not as difficult to deal with as the previous guardian Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate.

Moreover, Beiyin Venerate had watched the battle footage of this Galaxy Great Lord many times.

He considered himself to be very familiar with this newly emerged royalty from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

Even if they encountered an extreme situation and were discovered upon entry.

They could easily withdraw without exposing identity-related information.

Thus, even if the Fierce Sun Ancient Country pursued investigations afterward, as long as there was no substantial evidence, it would eventually come to nothing.

"Ten breaths."

"No more than ten breaths; regardless of how much Hei Yu is obtained, it must be immediately retreated."

Beiyin Venerate smoothly infiltrated the Hei Yu Nest and advised Jihan Venerate.

Ten breaths was precisely the time it took for the Fierce Sun Capital to transmit reinforcements to the Hei Yu Nest.

In simple terms, from the moment they infiltrated, reinforcements from Fierce Sun Capital would arrive in the fastest ten breaths.

The two Heavenly Venerates were not concerned about the Galaxy Great Lord, but the reinforcements from Fierce Sun Capital? They were somewhat apprehensive.

"Understood."

Jihan Venerate nodded.

Daring to infiltrate such a prime treasure ground, everything was certainly planned for the worst-case scenario.

With their Heavenly Venerate power, it was unlikely they would be spotted immediately upon entry.

But since it was a possibility, plans had to be made under that premise.

Swoosh.

In merely a tenth of a breath’s time, the two Heavenly Venerates completely infiltrated the Hei Yu Nest.

Swiftly approaching the area where Hei Yu was being nurtured.

...

Deep within the Hei Yu Nest.

Lin Yuan was refining Hei Yu, with threads of Hei Yu’s power slowly and steadily tempering his mental consciousness.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan suddenly felt a stir within, looking toward a certain direction.

"Two presences have infiltrated?"

Lin Yuan thought privately. His discovery of these two infiltrating presences was not based on the Hei Yu Nest’s grand array.

But purely relying on Lin Yuan’s own perception and the half-operating state of Divine Ability ’World’.

Since the Hei Yu Nest was about to enter its mature period, Lin Yuan had grown cautious, constantly half-operating Divine Ability ’World’.

Such powerful Heavenly Venerates like Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate, sought the chance to guard the Hei Yu Nest at the risk of offending four or five other Heavenly Venerates.

Let alone other Heavenly Venerates from ancient countries?

The stronger one’s strength, the greater the emphasis on mental consciousness.

This was also the reason Hei Yu Nest was considered a prime treasure ground.

A rare treasure that directly enhances mental consciousness, which was exceptionally scarce even among the six great ancient countries, enough to provoke contention among Heavenly Venerates.

"It should be two Heavenly Venerates, Xuanyin Ancient Country’s Heavenly Venerates?"

Lin Yuan, gazing far ahead at the two rapidly approaching presences.

Jihan Venerate and Beiyin Venerate, fully prepared, believed they could deceive others and evade the detection of Hei Yu Nest’s grand array.

Indeed, this was true.

The grand array of Hei Yu Nest had not detected the presences of these two Heavenly Venerates.

Of course, this was also because neither Jihan Venerate nor Beiyin Venerate had made any moves.

Though the defensive array could not detect them, under the shroud of Lin Yuan’s Divine Ability ’World’, everything was visible.

...

"Arrived, just ahead is the area where Hei Yu is nurtured."

Jihan Venerate and Beiyin Venerate felt a slight thrill, especially Beiyin Venerate, for since their entry, the Hei Yu Nest’s grand array hadn’t shown any abnormal fluctuations.

Estimate that the Galaxy Great Lord hadn’t noticed us at all.

"Two breaths have passed, three breaths for retreat, leaving us five breaths to collect Hei Yu."

Beiyin Venerate glanced at Jihan Venerate.

Jihan Venerate immediately nodded.

Having cultivated to the Heavenly Venerate Realm, naturally, one would not lose reason in front of treasures, everything would proceed according to the plan.

Whirr.

The next moment.

The two Heavenly Venerates entered the area where Hei Yu was nurtured.

A vast expanse of deep black jade appeared before them, and both Jihan Venerate and Beiyin Venerate suppressed their delight.

"Take them all, even the immature Hei Yu."

Beiyin Venerate quickly said.

The rare Hei Yu nurtured by the Hei Yu Nest would only be taken out when fully mature and thereby circulated.

But it was not to say immature Hei Yu would be completely ineffective; it only lacked the profound tempering effect on mental consciousness compared to mature Hei Yu.

And now, as raiders, Jihan Venerate and Beiyin Venerate naturally disregarded whether the Hei Yu was mature or not, taking everything in sight.

However.

When their power enveloped the Hei Yu, they found multiple layers of time-space barriers faintly coalesced around all Hei Yu.

"What’s going on?"

Beiyin Venerate frowned, sensing the time-space barriers, not deriving from the Hei Yu Nest’s defensive grand array.

"Beiyin, what now, I can’t take it."

Jihan Venerate quickly inquired, covering large patches of Hei Yu with the time-space barriers giving him a feeling of helplessness, unable to breach them.

"What now?"

Beiyin Venerate thought privately, suddenly his expression changed, looking upward, only to see a man step out from the void, quietly observing them from above.
